card.text: WASP-152B is a star of 3,909 K, bound to K2-29 763 AU away.

introduction.text: WASP-152B shares its motion through space with K2-29, 763 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

brightness-campaign-4.title: Brightness map, Campaign 4
brightness-campaign-4.summary: Darker and brighter longitudes of the star, worked out in this project from how its light changes as it turns.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Feb to Apr 2015
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
